description: This Java class 'StartupErrorFilter' is a web filter in the OpenMRS project. It handles error display during startup when database updates are needed or when errors occur during the initialization process. It extends 'StartupFilter' and manages GET requests to show error templates or reject POST requests during setup.

classes.name: StartupErrorFilter
classes.description: A web filter class responsible for handling startup errors in the OpenMRS application's initialization process.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests; renders an error template if an error occurred at startup.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Responds to POST requests with 405 Method Not Allowed, indicating POST is not supported during setup.

methods.name: getUpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Returns the current error model indicating the startup error state.

methods.name: skipFilter
methods.description: Determines whether to skip this filter based on whether an error occurred during startup.

methods.name: getTemplatePrefix
methods.description: Provides the template directory prefix used for rendering error pages.
